explore-parallel.title: Add branches
explore-parallel.prompt: Add 100 Ω resistors in parallel until there are four. Watch the total current.
hints: Use the + button next to Resistors.
explore-parallel.success: 480 mA: each branch takes 120 mA and the battery supplies them all. Total resistance fell to 25 Ω.

explore-series.title: Add resistors in a row
explore-series.prompt: Add 10 Ω resistors in series until there are four. What happens to the total resistance?
hints: Use the + button next to Resistors.
explore-series.success: 40 Ω: they simply add. A fifth would make 50 Ω.
